## LTX Watch Blender Auto-Pilot
Local planner only. This workflow talks to loopback Ollama and never receives the LTX Watch control token.
Paste the JSON into Create → Blender Auto-Pilot, or let Watch orchestrate Ollama itself.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'qwen2.5-coder:14b-agent', stream: false, format: 'json', keep_alive: 0, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Return only JSON for kind blender-autopilot-scene. Allowed primitives: planet, moon, torus-halo, gothic-machine-cathedral, geodesic-biodome, ship, satellite, laser, camera-orbit, empty-rig. No Python.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt || 'Final Override introduction: Earth, halo, moon, gothic machine-datacenter cathedral, biodome.' }] }) }}
